title: Apparatuses, systems, and methods for analog accumulator for determining row access rate and target row address used for refresh operation
query: analog row access rate determination capacitor accumulator row hammer DRAM patent
supports: Micron patent: a matched tracked row address adds a set charge to an accumulator capacitor that leaks over time; the voltage gives access rate, and a voltage-to-time circuit picks the row for targeted (row hammer) refresh (via search snippet)

title: Apparatuses and methods for analog row access tracking
query: analog row access rate determination capacitor accumulator row hammer DRAM patent
supports: Sibling Micron patent: analog row access tracking, motivated because tracking every row access with digital counters may be difficult under space/power limits; related US 10,964,378 refreshes neighbours of the highest-voltage row (via search snippet)
